text:
Maya Chen: quick check — vendor sent partial H100 rack to us (ETA tomorrow), procurement flagged a 72h smoke-test SLA before we can put into production. can infra team confirm if we can stage 8 GPUs into demo pool for a 48h borrow instead of full prod?

Leo Park: @Maya Chen can you paste the vendor SLA excerpt? need to confirm we won't violate the 72h gating.

Maya Chen: here it is — vendor email: 'hardware handover is on 2026-03-22, production acceptance test window 72 hours mandatory; provisional staging for validation may be allowed under partner-delegated custody'. I'll DM the PDF.

Priya Singh: quick thought — procurement + security will insist on full telemetry/firmware audit if moved directly into prod. 48h demo borrow sounds fine for dev-only, but nodes must be isolated and labeled.

Jamal SRE: Agree with Priya. We can carve a temporary tenant in the demo pool (ephemeral-* namespace) and enforce network isolation. I need a node-label/tag spec from product.

Maya Chen: product asked for this tag scheme for cost & audit:  
```
redwood:team=search
redwood:env=demo
redwood:procurement_ref=PO-48291
redwood:temp_borrow=true
```

Leo Park: That looks OK. Two questions: 1) will KMS keys be used for this hardware right away? 2) does finance need the PO before we tag? @finance-bot?

finance-bot: Automated note — finance prefers PO on file for any billable hardware > $50k. Temporary flagging is OK but please escalate if vendor invoice is pending.

VendorSally: Confirming vendor is OK with temporary staging under partner custody. We can delay third-party validation until final acceptance if Redwood agrees in writing.

Priya Singh: Operational checklist for staging borrow: 1) net-isolate (VLAN + firewall rules), 2) node-labels as above, 3) SSH bastion only via jump host, 4) firmware snapshot + baseline hash capture, 5) telemetry collection enabled to our central bucket.

Jamal SRE: I can provision the VLAN and temporary node pool. Estimated time: 3 hours after I get the node hostnames or rack IDs. Also adding an autoscaler hold to avoid onboarding into shared pools.

Maya Chen: Rack IDs (from vendor): RCK-33A4 (hosts: h100-33a4-{01..08}). I'll DM the full manifest.

Leo Park: Will owners of demo workloads be informed? I'll ping the demo-team channel now; we should freeze automated CI that might pick up new nodes.

Priya Singh: Security note — we need firmware hashes before any root-level access. Jamal, can you snapshot and share checksums in this thread once done?

Jamal SRE: Yep — I'll run the baseline script and post output. snippet I'll run: 
```
ssh root@h100-33a4-01 'fwupdmgr get-devices && sha256sum /lib/firmware/*' > /tmp/h100-33a4-fw-hashes.txt
```

VendorSally: Vendor will provide signed firmware manifest too. forwarding now.

Maya Chen: thanks — plan then: vendor docks tomorrow morning, Jamal will stage nodes into ephemeral demo pool with labels and isolation, Priya will run security checks, finance will accept PO for temporary hold, vendor holds off final acceptance until 72h smoke window completes.

Leo Park: Ack. If everything checks out we can flip to dedicated pool after smoke-test. Can someone create a short PR to the infra runbook documenting the borrow flow? I'll take the PR review.

Maya Chen: I'll open the PR and @Leo Park for review. tagging this thread as action-required. :white_check_mark:

Jamal SRE: Started baseline run, will post hashes in ~45m.

Priya Singh: I'll schedule a 30m security quick-scan after Jamal posts hashes.

finance-bot: Noted. PO record requested — please attach PO-48291 to the ticket.

Maya Chen: attaching P.O. to internal ticket now. thanks all.

Jamal SRE: baseline hashes uploaded to /s3/telemetry/h100-33a4/manifest.txt. quick excerpt:
```
h100-33a4-01: sha256:ab12...f3e4
h100-33a4-02: sha256:9c8a...a7d2
```

Priya Singh: Received hashes, starting firmware diff scan.

VendorSally: Vendor note — firmware signed manifest matches uploaded hashes.

Maya Chen: closing loop — staging started, we have isolation and labels, smoke-test window starts when Jamal marks CI green. will post final status here.
